simple.summary: אֲחִיהוּד (ʼĂchîyhûwd) means Achihud , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Num 34 27.

definitions.full: H282. Achihud אֲחִיהוּד proper name, masculine prince of Asher Num 34:27 ; ( brother of majesty , compare אֲבִיהוּד הוֺד, ; see also אֲחִיחֻד ),
definitions.rootNote: from 251 and 1935 ; brother (i.e. possessor) of renown;
